description.value: The Liquor Co. 1977 is a member-owned cooperative liquor store on Yates Street in the heart of downtown Victoria, one of 10 locations operating under the Peninsula Co-op network across Vancouver Island. The co-op traces its roots to 1977, when Saanich Peninsula residents banded together around shared community values, and it continues to emphasize local products, profit-sharing with members, and community investment. Touring cyclists passing through downtown Victoria can stop in for a selection of beer, wine, and spirits.
